description: Customer quotes with attribution — for social proof sections. 'grid' layout lays out quote cards 1-col mobile / 2-3 col desktop; 'stack' layout is a single centered column for one or two large quotes. THE FIRST COMPONENT REBUILT ON THE UNIVERSAL DESIGN CONTRACT (v2): it declares no style slots. Every designable value — colour, type, spacing, border, shadow, size — is set through the `udc` map on the band, per role. See docs/v2/BUILD-SPEC-sprint0.md §3.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors). This is the author's anchor name and is NOT the band id that scopes this band's styling — that one is the top-level "id" on the composition item and the engine mints it.

title.description: Section heading above the testimonials. Omit if the context makes it clear. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored. Colour it through the `heading-accent` role.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered above the title. Plain text — HTML is escaped. Its pill treatment (background, radius, padding, casing) is the `eyebrow` role's design, not a fixed style.

subheading.description: Optional supporting line below the title. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

layout.description: Structural layout — this is scaffolding, not styling, which is why it is still a prop. 'grid' = card grid, 1-col mobile / 2-3 col desktop, and a lone card spans the full track rather than sitting in a half-width column. 'stack' = single centered column, for one or two large pull-quotes. BOTH layouts get the same card design: to render a frameless quote, set the `card` role's border width to 0 and its background to transparent.

items.description: Array of testimonial items. Each: { quote (req), author, role, company, image_url, image_alt, image_id }.

quote.description: The testimonial text. Inline HTML allowed: a, strong, em, br.

author.description: Name of the person quoted. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the avatar. Use the author's name; empty string only if image is purely decorative.

image_id.description: Media Library attachment ID (NOT a URL). When it resolves to a real attachment, the image renders responsively with srcset/sizes via wp_get_attachment_image() instead of a single fixed-size . Falls back to image_url when unset or unresolvable. Get an attachment id via the import_media apply.

retired_props._note: Props this component declared on 1.x that the v2 rebuild retired (#1007). Each value names the v2 surface that replaced it, so a refusal can offer a route instead of a list of live prop names. Guarded by SchemaValidationTest in both directions.
retired_props.theme: the `_band` role's `background` group for the surface, plus `typography.color` on the text roles (`heading`, `quote`, `attribution`) — v2 has no single dark/light switch, because every value is authorable
retired_props.title_align: the `heading` role's `typography.align` in the `udc` map (and `heading-accent` if you accent it)

_band.description: The band itself — the <section>. Set the band's own background here to make a dark or tinted band; the v1 `theme` prop is gone because a preset bundle of colours is exactly what the UDC expresses directly.

eyebrow.description: The kicker pill above the heading.

heading-accent.description: The accented substring inside the heading, rendered only when title_accent matches.

subheading.description: The supporting line below the heading.

list.description: The container the cards lay out in. Its track geometry is structural; the space between cards is design.

card.description: One testimonial's surface. The #901 brand card — white, 1px border, no elevation — is this role's border, background and shadow.

quote.description: The quotation itself. Family, style, size and alignment all live here — the four properties #901 reported as unreachable in v1.

attribution.description: The attribution row (avatar + name + role/company). A rule above it is this role's border-top.

meta.description: The role/company line under the name.

avatar.description: The author's picture. Its box is design, not structure: size and shape are both set here.

safe_to_edit: ../../assets/css/components.css (COMPONENT: testimonials section — STRUCTURAL CSS ONLY: layout scaffolding and accessibility affordances. No colour, type, size, spacing, border or shadow value may be added there; every one of those belongs to a role above.)
